data.standardized_narrative: The gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 (prior year closing balance) is recorded as GBP 341.743m on the Balance Sheet. The report pages available did not present a clearly labelled gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' amount in the Insurance liabilities (gross) column, nor an explicit gross prior-year development narrative that could be confidently extracted. Consequently no quantified gross prior year reserve movement has been reported here.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding was taken from the Balance Sheet (2015 comparative column) on page 11 and transcribed as GBP 341.743m. The report images are low-resolution/rotated and many notes and tables (notably the specific 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column or a gross prior-year development reconciliation) could not be unambiguously read. The Profit & Loss technical account contains 'claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' rows (a P&L measure) but per instructions those are not valid for prior year reserve movement and were therefore not used. No clear gross PYD number (Insurance liabilities column) was found; prior_year_development_gbp_m is therefore null. If higher-resolution images or the original PDF are provided, the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' technical reserves note and the claims development triangle should be re-checked for a gross PYD figure. If only a NET prior-year movement is available in the document, that could be used as a fallback but was not located here.
